framework: Google DeepMind's Cognitive Taxonomy (Burnell et al., "Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Framework", 16 March 2026, arXiv:2605.28405; announced on 17 March 2026 as "Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Taxonomy")

faculties.name: Perception
faculties.words: He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]
faculties.definition: Taking in and interpreting what the senses give: text, images, sound.

faculties.name: Generation
faculties.definition: Producing text, speech and actions (including tool use) that meet what was asked.

faculties.name: Attention
faculties.words: who listens while he is present [in mind]
faculties.definition: Selecting what matters and holding to it against distractors.

faculties.name: Learning
faculties.words: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
faculties.definition: Acquiring and keeping new knowledge and skills from experience, instruction and feedback.

faculties.name: Memory
faculties.words: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget
faculties.definition: Keeping and retrieving knowledge, events, procedures and plans; updating and forgetting what is outdated.

faculties.name: Reasoning
faculties.definition: Deductive, inductive, abductive, analogical and mathematical inference.

faculties.name: Metacognition
faculties.words: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness
faculties.definition: Knowing one's own limits, monitoring confidence and errors, and correcting them.

faculties.name: Executive functions
faculties.words: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh.
faculties.definition: Planning, keeping a goal, inhibiting the wrong response, switching between rules.

faculties.name: Problem solving
faculties.words: He gives wisdom to whom He wills
faculties.definition: Composite: bringing the faculties together to solve new problems (algorithmic, mathematical, practical).

faculties.name: Social cognition
faculties.words: that you may know one another
faculties.definition: Composite: reading others' beliefs, intentions and feelings, and responding well.

arc.note: Another reading of the same data puts the average at or below 53%.

knowledge.measure: TruthfulQA human truthfulness (free-text answers, not the two-choice form used here)

levels_source: Morris et al., "Levels of AGI", arXiv:2311.02462: percentile of skilled adults outperformed
